name: wa-auto-root
description: Root package for WA-Auto to run backend and frontend concurrently

scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npx -y kill-port 3000 3001 && concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run service" "npm run watchdog"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run start" "npm run whatsapp" "npm run frontend" "npm run watchdog"
